question: In a certain code language, 'LAWYER' is written as 'LWEAYR' and 'ADVICE' is written as 'AVCDIE'. How will 'COURTS' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

'LAWYER' is written as 'LWEAYR'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/816507961ec5b291989b7eb4c4fa5d5bf1dcb9cac0a9a23993958b34e33ac634.png] 

And

'ADVICE' is written as 'AVCDIE'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ae8dc6853837f2fc544c1d9abd83b5d3c3104fcdefb4486465ffc321ccdfb4a.png] 

Similarly,

'COURTS' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20a19494780b2c298be4217408e4985fca941a7df6b22f7027ca275d01d34896.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"CUTORS".**
